in_marathi.name: Nithinraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nithinraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nithi means 'day' and raj means 'rule' or 'grace'. The name Nithinraj signifies the grace of God that is present every day.

in_bengali.name: Nithinraj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's Grace
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nithinraj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Nithi means 'day' and raj means 'rule' or 'grace'. The name Nithinraj signifies the grace of God that is present every day.

vedic_reference.note: Nithinraj is a compound name derived from the Sanskrit words Nitya (eternal) and Raja (king). It is a popular name in Hindu communities, particularly in India, and is believed to convey the idea of an eternal monarch or ruler.
